uplink.description: standard report: all 10 digital input states (In'O bitmap16, cluster 0x8005 attr 0) | payload 110A80050000190371
uplink._note: The proprietary multi-binary-input cluster is the one frame that carries every input at once: bitmap 0x0371, bits 0-7 from the low byte (inputs 1-8) and bits 8-9 from the high byte (inputs 9-10). Ten entries, endpoint0..endpoint9, matching upstream pin_state_1..pin_state_10 (T,F,F,F,T,T,T,F,T,T). This replaces the former action.contactState + contactState2..contactState10 flat keys.

uplink.description: standard report: binary input state closed on endpoint 0 (input 1) (cluster 0x000F attr 0x0055) | payload 110A000F00551001
uplink._note: byte0 0x11 -> endpoint ((0x11 & 0xE0) >> 5) | ((0x11 & 0x06) << 2) = 0. One ZCL standard report carries one attribute of one endpoint, so the frame yields a single channels[] entry. Upstream calls the same value pin_state_1. Satisfies the analog-interface category through the entry.

uplink.description: standard report: binary input state open on endpoint 1 (input 2) (cluster 0x000F attr 0x0055) | payload 210A000F00551000
uplink._note: Second input position, re-encoded from the documented frame-control packing: byte0 0x21 -> endpoint ((0x21 & 0xE0) >> 5) | ((0x21 & 0x06) << 2) = 1 (upstream pin_state_2). Value byte 0 -> open.

uplink.description: standard report: pulse count 0 on endpoint 0 (input 1) (cluster 0x000F attr 0x0402, uint32) | payload 110A000F04022300000000
uplink._note: Cumulative index for input 1 (upstream index_1), now scoped to its endpoint entry instead of the bare pulse.total key.

uplink.description: standard report: pulse count 1234567 on endpoint 9 (input 10) (cluster 0x000F attr 0x0402, uint32) | payload 230A000F0402230012D687
uplink._note: Highest input position (the 10th input), re-encoded from the documented frame-control packing: byte0 0x23 -> endpoint ((0x23 & 0xE0) >> 5) | ((0x23 & 0x06) << 2) = 1 | 8 = 9 (upstream index_10). Counter 0x0012D687 = 1234567. The old codec had no branch past its hard-coded list, so this frame was mislabelled; the generic endpoint decode fixes it.

uplink.description: standard report: analog input present value 13.0 on endpoint 0 (cluster 0x000C attr 0x0055, float32) | payload 110A000C00553941500000
uplink._note: IEEE-754 single 0x41500000 = 13.0, passed through as analog.raw (the attached probe defines the unit), scoped to the reporting endpoint.

uplink.description: standard report: relay output 1 state ON (cluster 0x0006 attr 0x0000) | payload 110A000600001001
uplink._note: A relay is actuator state, not a measured input position, so it stays a top-level extra (AUTHORING.md allows naming an extra for something that is not a position) and the frame emits no channels key. Upstream calls it output_1.

uplink.description: standard report: disposable battery voltage 3.688 V (cluster 0x0050 attr 6) | payload 110A00500006410503040E6804
uplink._note: Power-configuration report: the rail is a whole-device reading, not an input's, so battery stays top-level and the frame emits no channels key.
